_comment: Known-answer vectors for the Discrete PQ Phase 1 domain-separated derivations
(spec v2.4, sections 6 and 8). These are the published cross-implementation
test vectors: any node software must reproduce them byte-for-byte. A mismatch
is a chain split (spec section 14), so these values never change once shipped.
Fixed inputs use pat(N,a,b)[i] = (i*a + b) mod 256, i in [0,N).
Integers (prevOutIndex, amount, fee, T) are little-endian on the wire.
All outputs are SHA3-256 / HKDF-SHA3-256 (FIPS 202/SP800-56C), hex-encoded.

view_seed._note: L=64 (FIPS 203 KeyGen d||z); spec L=32 is overridden — see PqSeed.h.

spend_seed._note: ML-DSA-65 xi for the long-term spend keypair (ownership-model fix). L=32 used directly as FIPS 204 xi.

out_context._note: SHA3-256(domain || inputs_hash || kem_ct || LE32(output_index) || LE64(T)). T is the deposit subaddress index; 0 for single-address wallets.

pq_output_enc_payload._note: ChaCha20-Poly1305(key=aead_key, nonce=00*12, aad=out_context||LE64(amount), msg=rho||LE64(T)). 56 bytes (40 ct + 16 tag).

spend_commit._note: spend_pub is the recipient's long-term ML-DSA-65 spend key (ownership-model fix).

nullifier._note: SHA3-256(domain || spend_pub || rho || prev_txid || LE32(prev_out_index)). The outpoint is bound so a public rho cannot be replayed into a colliding output.

tx_signing_digest._note: Amended §8.1: binds version || txType || LE64(unlockHeight) || inputs || outputs || LE32(extra_len)||extra || LE64(fee). Each output binds type || LE64(amount) || LE64(unlockHeight) || kemCt || encPayload || spendCommit. txType/tx-unlockHeight/extra and the per-output unlockHeight are bound to close malleability gaps (txid covers them).
